newsitem.title: GERMANY: Polish leader says Kohl's favourite dish delicious.
newsitem.headline: Polish leader says Kohl's favourite dish delicious.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl's favourite dish -- stuffed pig stomach -- garnered rave reviews from Poland's President Alexander Kwasniewski on Monday.
"We are most thankful to you that we were finally able to try your Saumagen," Kwasniewski told Kohl after a working lunch in Bonn. "It was really delicious."

A wide smile spread across Kohl's face. He quickly pointed out that Kwasniewski had made a special request to sample the dish, a southern German speciality that Kohl has tried out on American presidents and Soviet leaders.
"This shows that stuffed pig stomach has acquired an international standing," Kohl said.
